svg.text: Searches for “gpt” barely registered around GPT-3,
Google Trends, worldwide web search, monthly, Sep 2018 to Sep 2026. Each row is indexed to its own peak.
Each row is scaled to its own busiest month, which is 100. So the rows show shape, not size. Before 2022, most
searches for “llm” were about the law degree.
Source: Google Trends, worldwide, monthly, retrieved 2026-09-09.
